bolt11_pay.note: Send accepts only lno offers; setup invoices must be paid elsewhere

bolt11_receive.note: Single-use invoice with provider route hint; app must stay open

bolt12_pay.note: Only async static-invoice flow; needs imported profile route, async provider

bolt12_receive.note: Reusable offer needs imported async-provider profile; mainnet presets lack receive config

offline_receive.note: LDK-style async hold/release via imported profile only; no push

lnurl.note: No LNURL code; send input parses BOLT12 offers only

ln_address_pay.note: No Lightning address resolution; only lno offers accepted

ln_address_receive.note: Receive offers BOLT11 invoice or BOLT12 offer only

keysend.note: Keysend TLV used only internally for async payments; no user keysend

choose_peer.note: Olympus by ZEUS, Megalith, LNServer Wave, or import any node profile; one channel

jit_channels.note: LSPS1 inbound purchase (Olympus, Megalith); fee paid externally; no LSPS2

splicing.note: Docs: splicing not implemented or advertised

local_pathfinding.note: Configured-route client; gossip ignored; no graph routing

watchtower.note: No external watchtower; iOS background checks relay pre-signed recovery txs

channel_backup.note: Journal stays on device; iCloud backup disabled in Lightning app

onchain_independent.note: Single-key BIP86 Taproot wallet; channels are funded from it, not the reverse

multisig.note: Threshold shared savings (e.g. 2-of-3) and MuSig2 accounts

hw_signer.note: PSBT/MuSig2 cosigning with another device (Core tested); hardware wallets unverified

coin_control.note: Automatic coin selection over all spendable UTXOs; coins list read-only
